label: Plant logic
info: The canworks plant's control in FUXA's built-in Node-RED, on the canworks bridge node "canworks plant" of the exported flow. The HMI is FUXA's: values go to the tags of the FUXA Server device, and the operator's limit, Ack, running light and manual outputs come back from them. See examples/fuxa-node-red/README.md.
